title: Sales leaves out the closed internal work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Open Reports > Sales, set the date range to today and note its totals.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, invoiced today, billable, with one labor line of 2.0 hours at $120.00 an hour ($240.00), invoiced after the figures were noted.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 2, for internal customer A, closed today, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2 and one approved labor line of 2.0 hours, closed after the figures were noted.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports > Sales.
  2. Set the date range to today.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales opens.

Step 2:

  • Revenue is the noted figure plus $240.00 from work order 1, and labor hours the noted figure plus 2.0.
  • Work order 2 adds nothing: no revenue, no cost, no hours, and it is not listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-R1: “Sales, Sales By Customer, Sales By Representative and Advisor Analysis leave whole internal and no-charge work orders out of every number, with no filter and no option to include them. On a billable work order they leave every no-charge line out of labor revenue, parts revenue, labor cost, parts cost, invoiced hours and worked hours, the way a declined line is left out today: the invoice financial snapshot captures the no-charge lines as excluded, and the per-statement queries carry the same condition. The work order itself stays in with its billable amounts. Every dashboard card and ranking (Sales, Sales by Customer, Top Customers with its invoice count, At-Risk Customers, Billing, and the Invoices card, "Total invoices in range") does the same. The dashboard Tech Efficiency card follows the Technician Efficiency report's default (Show all, S9-R3), so the card and the report give the same hours for a technician.”
  • Key Decisions: “One report for free work; the money reports leave internal and no-charge work orders out with no filter.”
  • Goals: “Sales and margin reports exclude internal and no-charge work orders; one report of their own shows them with cost, hours and category.”
  • Feature Overview: “Reports: dollars out, hours in, per work order and per line. Whole internal and no-charge work orders stay out of the money reports as before. A no-charge line on a billable work order is left out the same way by every number that sums revenue, cost, margin, invoiced hours or units per line (Story 9 names each report); its clocked hours stay in the time reports; the work order itself stays in with its billable amounts. The Internal Work Orders report lists whole work orders and single lines with classification, category, original work order and line, original technician, parts cost and hours, with a per-category summary strip and a By technician tab (completed lines, comeback lines, warranty lines, comeback rate, redo hours, redo parts cost).”
